writeRoutes.workspaceScope: installation registry plus selected or proposed root

writeRoutes.targetAuthority: InstallationContext owns installation configuration and the BrowserProfile registry; root bindings remain explicit root-local facts.

writeRoutes.workspaceScope: selected root pi-agent/runtime-overrides

writeRoutes.targetAuthority: Pi is a bounded worker lease, never a second business authority; business writes require dispatcher identity/grants while compatible sessions remain readable.

profilePaths.currentAuthority: Coordinates rate/interaction ownership but has no workspace, task, grant, or runtime authority.
